questions.q: Why did Joseph have his silver cup put in Benjamin's sack?
choices: To hold Benjamin a while and draw out word of his father
questions.explain: He was not seeking harm; it set the stage for Judah to speak the whole history.

questions.q: What did Jacob fear losing Benjamin would do to him?
choices: Bring down his gray hairs with sorrow to the grave
questions.explain: Remove sorrow far from thee, for sorrow hath killed many.

choices: To abide as a bondman instead of the lad
questions.explain: He knew his father's life was bound up in the lad's life.
